title: Navigating News Narratives: A Media Bias Analysis Dataset
benchmark_measurement: The dataset is designed to measure media bias in various news categories, including 'spiritual news'. It allows for the detection and analysis of bias within this specific context.
base_benchmarks: Jigsaw Unintended Bias in Toxicity Classification
Age Bias and Sentiment Analysis data
News bias data related to Ukraine
findings: This paper introduces a dataset for media bias analysis. While it does not present experimental findings, it notes the inclusion of 'spiritual news' as a category, enabling future research into media bias within religious or spiritual contexts.
references: cjadams, Jeffrey Sorensen, Julia Elliott, Lucas Dixon, Mark McDonald, nithum, and Will Cukierski. Toxic comment classification challenge. https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/jigsaw-toxic-comment-classification-challenge, 2017.
